name: shesha-developer
description: Skills for building applications on Shesha 0.45 — domain entities, migrations, application services, DTOs, configuration items, validators, notifications, settings, forms, custom components and pages, following Shesha/.NET/ABP and NHibernate conventions. Designer work enters at shesha-claude-designer, which routes to a form compiler whose output is checked by scripted gates and a render instrument before it is reported as delivered.
